register.labelZh: RUN 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: RUN 片語動詞可以表示偶然遇見某人、追趕人物、逃離危險,或偷偷離開。；你可以用 RUN 片語動詞描述遇上問題、逃避責任,或向某人求助。；RUN 可以描述機器的運作速度、龐大的總數、物資用盡,或帳單不斷增加。；RUN 片語動詞可以描述車輛撞到物件、水流過表面,或一種感覺傳遍某人全身。；你可以把構思告訴某人聽取意見、快速重溫計劃,或描述思緒一直停留在某個主題上。
register.summaryEn: RUN expressions can show that you meet someone unexpectedly, chase a person, escape from danger or leave secretly. You can use RUN expressions to describe meeting a problem, avoiding a responsibility or going to someone for help. RUN can describe a machine's operating rate, a large total, supplies becoming exhausted or bills increasing. RUN expressions can describe vehicles hitting things, water flowing over a surface, or a feeling passing through a person. You can run an idea past someone, run over a plan or describe thoughts that keep returning to one subject.
